name: SatQuery Multimodal Dual-Stream RS Adapter
description: Domain-adapted dual-stream vision-language adapter trained on paired Sentinel-1 SAR (C-band dual-pol VV/VH) and Sentinel-2 Multispectral Optical imagery from BigEarthNet.txt with 19 CORINE land-cover classes.

training_details.loss_function: Multi-label BCEWithLogitsLoss + Symmetric InfoNCE Contrastive Alignment

limitations: Trained on 10m to 20m equivalent ground sampling distance; sub-meter Cartosat imagery benefits from spatial interpolation.
Cloud occlusion over optical imagery requires SAR stream activation for reliable dielectric surface penetration.
